# DevMarvibe

> DevMarvibe is a full-service digital partner that builds web and mobile apps, backend systems and digital products, and runs branding, content and growth marketing for businesses. Based in India; reachable at hello@devmarvibe.com or +91 99599 25779.

## Pages

- [Home](https://devmarvibe.com/): services, products, client stories and the contact form
- [Services](https://devmarvibe.com/#services): what DevMarvibe offers
- [Products](https://devmarvibe.com/#products): ready-made software products
- [Packages](https://devmarvibe.com/packages): Starter (Launchpad), Growth Studio and Enterprise Suite web and mobile app packages, with a comparison table
- [Contact us](https://devmarvibe.com/contact): send a project enquiry, optionally for a specific package
- [Share a testimonial](https://devmarvibe.com/testimonials/request): clients and partners can submit feedback for review
- [Report a security issue](https://devmarvibe.com/security): responsible disclosure form

## Services

- Web & Mobile Development: responsive web and mobile apps tailored to business goals and users
- Backend Development: secure, scalable backend systems that power apps and core operations
- Branding & Design: brand systems and digital experiences
- Content Writing: clear, SEO-friendly content
- Social Media Marketing: targeted content and audience engagement
- Paid Campaigns: data-led PPC and ad campaigns focused on reach, conversion and ROI
- SEO: search strategies that bring qualified traffic
- Accounting & Tax Solutions: financial support for compliance and business decisions

## Packages

Every package is also available as an Android and iOS app with the same scope.

- Starter (Launchpad): the client supplies the content; DevMarvibe builds a responsive, interactive website hosted and managed on console.devmarvibe.com. Designer and content writer cost extra. Price on request.
- Growth Studio: done for you — designer, content writer and market, competitor and keyword research included; integrations such as payments, notifications, maps and analytics; runs on console.devmarvibe.com, with console API usage billed separately. Price on request.
- Enterprise Suite: a fully custom web application with its own admin panel, dedicated database, user roles, integrations, reports, testing and deployment. Quoted per project.

## Products

- [DMV App Console](https://console.devmarvibe.com): a multi-tenant SaaS console for individuals, recruiters and companies — branded portfolios, hiring pipelines, resume analytics and lead capture, API-ready
